integrity: The proof separates exact algebraic and convex arguments from finite numerical corroboration. Historical novelty is supported by targeted searches and full inspection of the closest primary source, but search failure alone is not treated as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles only the path \(P_8\) (\(q=9\)). It proves existence, not explicit numerical readout times or support minimality, and it does not classify the remaining rationally dependent moduli.
title: Uniform average mixing on the eight-vertex path \(P_8\)
